quote.text: We don't outsource our expertise. We are the expertise. Born from real work inside reactor vessels and server rooms — not from a business plan template.

about.story_p1: GEMBA Team was born from an unusual journey. Our founder spent over a decade working in two parallel worlds — servicing reactors and managing catalyst changeouts at some of Europe's most demanding refineries, while simultaneously building server infrastructure, payment systems, and blockchain solutions from the ground up.
about.story_p2: This isn't a corporate story written by a marketing department. It's the story of someone who has crawled inside reactor vessels at Shell and ExxonMobil, and then sat down to write the code that processes payments for merchants across three blockchain networks. Someone who understands both the weight of a catalyst bed and the weight of a database under load.
about.story_p3: In January 2026, these two worlds became one company. GEMBA Team brings together industrial services and technology under a single roof — not as a corporate experiment, but as a natural evolution of real, lived experience.
about.story_p4: We don't outsource our expertise. We are the expertise.
about.mission: To deliver industrial and technology services of uncompromising quality, built on first-hand experience and driven by the belief that real expertise cannot be shortcuts.
about.vision: To become the partner of choice for businesses that refuse to compromise — whether they need a reactor serviced or a payment system built.

team.name: Slavcho Ivanov
team.bio: Over 10 years of experience in catalyst changeout operations and reactor servicing at major European refineries including Shell, ExxonMobil, BP, Neste, and ORLEN. Simultaneously, 20+ years of self-taught expertise in IT infrastructure, DevOps, full-stack development, and blockchain technology. SCC/VCA certified (TÜV Rheinland), BA/N2 inert entry qualified, with additional certifications in confined space operations, crane operation, rigging, and forklift handling. Education in Public Administration with advanced studies in Cybersecurity.
team.tagline: The rare professional who can service a reactor on Monday and deploy a payment gateway on Tuesday.
